_doc: [orbC] The Bot Fabricator (robots/fabricator/bot_fabricator.gd): a Hub build (data/builds.json id bot_fabricator) that builds robots on its own from cubes and parts, on a mix the player sets in its panel (ui/fabricator_panel.gd). Unlocked from the campaign planet unlock_planet on (Tidewell, 3rd; docs/DECISIONS.md 'Planets differ in size'). Each robot costs the type's base cost and parts (data/robots.json) x cost_mult, with no per-robot growth, and takes build_s seconds. Pacing (orbC, Tidewell autoplay from a fresh start, Nov 8): income ~480 cubes/min and ~1.6k parts by 90 min at base 2, so the Fabricator (8k + 300) lands around base 2 (~45-70 min) and a Scoopie (385 + 25 parts) every 1-2 min of income. The fleet cap on a round planet is cap_per_kcell robots per 1,000 hexes of that planet (planets.json globe frequency), so it scales with size: Verdance ~98, Tidewell ~166, Rime ~252, Anvil ~393. On a flat district the cap is flat_cap_crews x the hub's crew cap. Robots it builds are sent to the hub with the fewest robots and work there on their own (far crews keep it cheap: only near robots are real).
name: Bot Fabricator
desc: A bot that builds bots. Set the mix and it keeps the line running on cubes and parts, sending each new robot out to the hub that needs it most.
